# EML 2.2.0 XML Schema (upstream vendor copy)

Source: [NCEAS/eml](https://github.com/NCEAS/eml/tree/RELEASE_EML_2_2_0/xsd)
Tag: `RELEASE_EML_2_2_0` (Ecological Metadata Language 2.2.0).
The XSD files in this directory are unmodified upstream source files.
This directory contains the recursively required local XSD imports and includes,
including the XML namespace schema, for offline validation with lxml.

The original EML schema files carry their upstream licensing and copyright
notices. No project-specific profile or acceptance rule is included here.

For SHA-256 provenance, use `sha256sum vendor/schemas/eml/2.2.0/*.xsd`.
The export manifest records the exact SHA-256 of the entry-point `eml.xsd`.
The official EML distribution and this pinned tag are the source of truth.
